observed_failure: An overbroad inventory sent a pure infrastructure-failure record with no path/SHA pair to the fingerprint binding validator, which correctly raised BindingValidationError. A following shasum command then made the combined shell exit code zero because shell errexit was not enabled.
repair: Use a finite explicit list of records that contain recognized file bindings and run the validator as a standalone failure-propagating command; validate pure failure records only for JSON parseability and ledger evidence hash.
